title: 第二十五章 再遇第二十六章 战妖兽
lines: 雷涅行走在此片血色荒漠中，扭首遥望源方的天边，眼里不住的泛起一抹狐疑之色。
此刻，已是双国争斗结束的第二日，最终的结果不出意料的，以天玄国的胜利拉下帷幕。雷涅尚还能清楚的记得，那灵老头在得道一件，相较玄天宝葫，品质要高级其数筹的法宝时，嘴角流溢而出的一抹弧度。
对此雷涅心下略生出几分不畅之意，自己的法宝已在之前的争斗中损坏，加之给予灵青圣的玄天战舟……
现在雷涅相比于，与自己同阶的其他修士，可谓是一穷二白！
雷涅虽然于双国争斗中，付出如此一般的代价全身而退，但其早已在心中按下定计，誓要在血炼中的古宗遗址，寻出几件看得上眼的法宝灵药。
而这也就是，促使雷涅眼中闪出狐疑之色的原因之一。
另一点，就与旁人有所瓜葛了……
“那三人怎么还没到？！莫不成出了什么事？！”
雷涅低沉喃喃着，言语中已将“旁人”的身份给暴露个七七八八。
没错！所谓的旁人显然是指，在宗内相邀雷涅一起探宝的三名凡化境弟子。
此三人中，那名叫灵和真，为首的凡化境大成弟子，在尚未潜入荒漠深处前，曾与雷涅操控的第二躯体“叶不休”碰过一面，告诉雷涅在此时身处之地与之会面。
不过这都过了足有一炷香的时间了，还是不见三人踪影。
雷涅之所以会前来赴约，一者，雷涅根本不惧三人背地里使什么手段。二来，其在林化老道那里获取的古宗遗址信息着实太少了点，只有几处广为人知的巨宗遗址。
这些巨宗遗址，向来是各宗弟子率先踏足找寻宝物之所，其中争斗的激烈程度，必然甚为惨烈。
雷涅若是现在前往，必然阻力重重，虽说不至于有性命之忧，但麻烦定会接踵而至。
尤其自己第二躯体显露而出的表面实力，只是区区凝炼完玄气本源的层级。
如此孱弱的实力，说不得会招引其他人的诸般怀疑。
试想一下，能前往血炼之人，若不是没有强大的实力做为依仗，有谁会蠢到拿自己的性命做为赌注，前来此处，探寻机缘造化？！故而，雷涅做为……一个层次只滞留在低阶修士中末流的存在，就单凭此间一点，足以让人断定雷涅身上必然怀有，真正可以让其跨级争斗的手段！
而若想弥补与凡化境大成修士，甚至巅峰修士间庞大的差距，所需的手段可不仅仅只能停留在短暂的交手，这种粗烂的层面上！必须拥有与之相抗的真正本钱！
所以用脚趾头想，都能得到一种唯一的答案，那便是……
法器！
也只有法器这种存在，会短时间被玄石激发数次威能，做以抗衡之用！至于较高等级的法决，秘籍，即便施术者有玄石辅助，也断然不可能在短时间内，被一再催动。从而导致在争斗中，露出极大的破绽，而这一类破绽的显现，足以让敌人发起致命一击……
所以……这种任何人都能推衍出的可能，若是见到雷涅的低级修为，必然会在心中生出贪念，虽说要面临一件法器的威胁。
但相比之下，成功夺宝的可能性还是要大于，所要面临的风险。
再者，聚于巨宗遗址的修士，大多都是同门汇集，一并行动。如此这般，风险立马被均摊而开，更加使得想要夺宝之人，心中最后一丝顾忌烟消云散。
content_en:
Rene was walking in this bloody desert, turning his head to look at the horizon in the distance, with a hint of suspicion in his eyes.
At this moment, it was already the second day of the battle between the two countries. As expected, the final result ended with the victory of Tianxuan Kingdom. Rei Nieshang could still clearly remember the arc that came out of the corner of Old Man Ling's mouth when he learned about a magic weapon that was several times better in quality than the Xuantian Treasure Gourd.
Reine felt a little unhappy about this. His magic weapon had been damaged in the previous battle, and the Xuantian war boat given to Lingqing Sheng...
Now, compared to other monks at the same level as himself, Rene is completely poor!
Although Rene paid such an ordinary price to escape from the battle between the two countries, he had already made up his mind and vowed to find a few attractive magic weapons and elixirs at the ancient sect ruins in the blood refining.
And this was one of the reasons why Rene's eyes flashed with suspicion.
Another point is that it has something to do with others...
"Why haven't those three arrived yet?! Could something have happened?!"
Rene murmured in a low voice, and the identity of the "other person" was completely exposed in his words.
That's right! The so-called others obviously refer to the three Mortal Realm disciples who invited Reine to explore the treasure together in the sect.
Among these three people, the one named Ling Hezhen, the most accomplished disciple of the Mortal Realm, had met with the second body "Ye Buxiu" controlled by Reine before he dived into the depths of the desert, and told Rene to meet him where he was at this time.
However, enough time had passed for a stick of incense to be burned, and there was still no sign of the three of them.
The reason why Rene came to keep the appointment was that, first, Rene was not afraid of what the three of them would do behind the scenes. Secondly, the information on ancient sect ruins obtained from Linhua Laodao was too little, and there were only a few well-known giant sect ruins.
These giant sect ruins have always been the first places where disciples of each sect set foot in search of treasures, and the intensity of the battles there must have been fierce.
If Rene went there now, there would be a lot of resistance. Although his life would not be in danger, trouble would surely follow.
In particular, the superficial strength revealed by his second body is only the level of the original profound energy that has been condensed.
Such a weak strength would inevitably arouse all kinds of suspicion from others.
Just imagine, if those who can go to Blood Refining do not have strong strength to rely on, who would be stupid enough to use their own lives as a bet to come here to explore opportunities and fortune? ! Therefore, Reine is... an existence that only remains at the bottom of low-level monks. This alone is enough for people to conclude that Reine must have a means that can truly allow him to fight across levels!
And if you want to make up for the huge gap with the accomplished monks in the Mortal Realm, or even the peak monks, the means required are not just limited to a short confrontation, this rough level! You must have the real capital to fight against it!
So if you think about it with your toes, you can get the only answer, and that is...
Magic weapon!
There are only magical weapons that can be stimulated by black stones several times in a short period of time to counteract them! As for higher-level spells and secrets, even if the caster is assisted by black stones, it is absolutely impossible to activate them repeatedly in a short period of time. As a result, huge flaws are exposed in the battle, and the emergence of such flaws is enough for the enemy to launch a fatal blow...
Therefore... anyone can deduce the possibility that if one sees Reine's low-level cultivation, he will definitely have greed in his heart, even though he will face the threat of a magic weapon.
But in comparison, the possibility of successfully seizing the treasure is still greater than the risks to be faced.
Furthermore, most of the monks who gathered at the Juzong ruins were from the same sect and acted together. In this way, the risks are immediately spread evenly, which makes the last scruples in the hearts of those who want to seize the treasure disappear.
title_en: Chapter 25: Encounter Again Chapter 26: Fighting Monsters
